title: BookCoverTemplate
description: A reusable book cover template: style spec + prompt program + optional reference images. A template folder contains template.json plus an optional references/ directory with the reference images it uses.

layout.description: Deterministic cover composition (the parts the agent typesets live, outside the AI art).

composition.description: Where title/author/art sit, e.g. 'title top block, art below', 'full-bleed art with bottom title band'.

margins.description: Margin/grid rule, e.g. '10% safe zone, 4-col grid', 'Tschichold proportional margins'.

safeZone.description: Fraction of each edge kept clear of critical text.

classification.description: e.g. Didone, geometric sans, old-style serif, slab.

hierarchy.description: Scale note, e.g. 'title largest, subtitle secondary, author tertiary'.

contrast.description: e.g. 'high contrast type on quiet background'.

prompt.description: Prompt program for the AI art stage. Placeholders {title}, {author}, {subtitle}, {subject}, {tone}, {genre} are substituted by the CLI.

art.description: Art-generation prompt (text-free; final title/author is typeset live).

roleRefs.description: Instruction to the provider on how to treat reference images, e.g. 'use refs as style board: keep palette and texture, do not copy subjects'.

references.description: Reference images shipped in the template's references/ dir. Roles follow the provider-matrix vocabulary.

provider.description: Optional provider/model preference and output geometry.

preferred.description: Preferred provider ids in order, e.g. ['openrouter','gemini','openai','xai'].

refsLimit.description: Max provider refs; degrade by truncating deterministically.

provenance.description: Who made this template and from what.
